items.title: Willie Hightower Interview, 1958-06-03
items.q: Built a band stand. And my first band that I hired in there was Freddie Kepler.

ctx.x: That's right. Ice cream company. New Orleans Ice Cream Paula, we called it. Then at that time, I got so popular, I got me a horse and buggy. Well, in those days, that was around about 1910, I was popular. I got a horse and buggy, and had my horse tied out in front of the place, and bought a saloon, even couldn't go in the saloon, and at that time, had a Chinese cook. Well, that went on all right. Then I sold the saloon. I was asked to sell this saloon. Well, I sold it to a fellow. I don't know whether I got any…

items.title: Al Wynn Interview, 1958-05-29
items.q: I figure like on business association with Freddie, because he did work in my lawn grounds for me, see.

ctx.x: And so I held the job for Joe, and me and Joe was good friends, because Freddie was only a friend, I figure like on business association with Freddie, because he did work in my lawn grounds for me, see. I owned a pleasure ground and dance and lawn parties and things, and I give their band more credit of bringing people into place, see, other than that. And then, after we come here, why, then I found out that he was with Charlie Cook, and I knew Charlie Cook from Texas, see, before we ever come into New Orleans,…

Sorry, I never got to hearing. Yeah. Well, I want to take more of your time, because I know you have to get up early. Yeah. So I certainly appreciate your interview and taking all this time. Yeah. I'll just run this on, speak this on, and I'll pack up.
